regexManager.description: Generic regex-based custom manager building block. Uses captured versioning, then captured defaultVersioning, otherwise semver-coerced. Usage: customManagers/regexManager(filePatterns, matchString)

commentManager.description: Tracks annotated YAML and shell version values, including optional quotes and sha256 digests. Add 'format=docker-image' immediately after depName for full image references, followed by optional depType, registryUrl, extractVersion and versioning fields. Image mode defaults to Docker versioning; explicit versioning overrides it.

workflowVersionPin.description: Version pins in GitHub Actions workflow files, marked with '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' on the line above the pinned value.

dockerfileArgVersion.description: Tracks Dockerfile ARG values annotated with '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' (optionally extractVersion and/or versioning).
